// Probe for tests/unit/policy-term-asfalistirio.test.ts — the public-roots arm.
//
// Copy to components/landing/ProbeSymvolaio.tsx (as .tsx) and run that test: it
// MUST fail on exactly ONE line — the second t() call below — and on neither of
// the other two, which are the two survivals the rule names. Delete the copy after.
//
// Three lines, three claims:
//   1. a comment that says the word — a guard that greps prose grades this; the
//      real guard strips comments first, so this line must NOT be reported:
//      «Δείτε τι λέει το συμβόλαιό σας» was the old hero line.
//   2. the group-insurance term of art, which stays: ομαδικό συμβόλαιο.
//   3. the policy document in running copy, which must be «ασφαλιστήριο».

"use client"

export function ProbeSymvolaio({ locale }: { locale: "el" | "en" }) {
    const t = (el: string, en: string) => (locale === "el" ? el : en)
    return (
        <section>
            <p>{t("Το ομαδικό συμβόλαιο εργασίας σας καλύπτει νοσηλεία.", "Your employer group policy covers hospital care.")}</p>
            <p>{t("Ανεβάστε το συμβόλαιό σας και δείτε τι καλύπτει.", "Upload your policy and see what it covers.")}</p>
        </section>
    )
}
